classification: Six explicitly identified connector retention-pad groups, with two net-0 physical pads per group. These are mechanical mounting features, not connector circuit contacts.

sources.drawingTitle: MICRO FIT (3.0) RIGHT ANGLE SMT CLIPS
sources.evidence: The drawing lists 43650-0410 as the four-circuit finish-B part. It identifies two mounting-clip holes, diameter 2.41 mm, and a four-circuit dimension C of 13.30 mm between mounting holes. Notes 6 and 12 identify the clips as retention features; note 12 specifies plated holes for soldered retention.

The primary catalog identifies BM04B-SRSS-TB as four circuits at 1.00 mm pitch. The top-entry PCB layout shows two separate side retention pads, each 1.20 by 1.80 mm, outside the circuit-contact row. Their derived center span is 3.00 + 2*(0.70 + 1.20/2) = 5.60 mm.
